biggest_catch: You are paid only after the client approves your work — gigs are location-based and competitive, so in smaller towns there may be few or no gigs at all.
catches: Gigs are location-based (US, Canada, UK, select cities); availability in smaller towns can be near zero — check the map before counting on it.
PayPal account required to get paid; no other payout method on the official page.
Payment comes after client approval of your submission; rejections mean redoing the gig or no pay.
Gig density varies wildly by metro — big-city users see daily gigs, others see none.
Must be 18+; smartphone with location services required.

steps: Download the Gigwalk app (iOS/Android) and register with email + a few basic questions.
Link your PayPal email in app settings.
Browse the map/list for gigs near you; each listing shows payment amount, description, location.
Apply ('Apply to this Gig'), complete the gig per instructions, submit photos/answers in-app.
Client approves; payment is sent directly to your PayPal account.
timing: PayPal payout after the client approves your submitted gig — payment sent directly to your PayPal account on approval.
who_pays: The clients (brands and businesses posting gigs on Gigwalk) pay you per completed gig; Gigwalk sends the money to your PayPal once the client approves.
who_qualifies: 18+; a smartphone (iOS/Android) with location services on; a PayPal account. Available in the US, Canada, the UK, and select cities in Europe and Asia.
work_available: Location-based and competitive — big-city users see daily gigs, while smaller towns can have near zero. Check the gig map before counting on this.
what_gets_accepted: You are paid only after the client approves your submitted gig. You must be at the correct location with GPS on; rejections mean redoing the gig or no pay.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: travel to gig locations, time spent checking the app for gigs (they're first-come, first-served), and any gig the client rejects.
when_cash_arrives: Once the client approves your gig, the money is sent directly to your PayPal account.

repeatable.cadence: New gigs post in your area — complete a gig, get client approval, get paid via PayPal, and claim the next one.
